description: This file contains the 'Currency' controller class for the OpenCart system, handling currency display and saving operations within the storefront. It includes methods to display currency options and update the selected currency, interacting with session data, models, and views.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A controller class responsible for displaying and updating the site's currency-related options in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the currency selection view, populating it with available currencies and current selection.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of a new currency selection, updating session data, setting cookies, and redirecting accordingly.
